name: deployment-strategy
description: Choose and design deployment strategies (blue/green, canary, rolling, recreate, feature flags) that minimize risk, enable rapid rollback, and ensure high availability during application releases.
purpose: Design and implement deployment strategies that balance risk, speed, cost, and availability requirements.

required.name: application_characteristics
required.description: Application architecture, stateful/stateless nature, dependencies, startup time, resource requirements

required.name: availability_requirements
required.description: Uptime SLA, acceptable downtime, maintenance windows, business hours, RTO/RPO

required.name: traffic_patterns
required.description: Expected traffic volume, variability, user session duration, geographic distribution

required.name: risk_tolerance
required.description: Impact of failures, acceptable error rate, rollback time requirements, blast radius tolerance

required.name: infrastructure_capabilities
required.description: Deployment platform, load balancer capabilities, service mesh, monitoring tools, automation

optional.name: current_deployment_process
optional.description: Existing strategy, frequency, success rate, common failures, rollback procedures

optional.name: team_capabilities
optional.description: Team size, expertise, on-call coverage, automation maturity, incident response

optional.name: business_context
optional.description: Deployment frequency goals, release coordination, stakeholder notifications, competitive pressure

optional.name: technical_constraints
optional.description: Legacy integrations, network latency, data residency, compliance, budget

optional.name: feature_flag_infrastructure
optional.description: Existing feature flag system, maturity, dynamic configuration, user targeting

primary.name: deployment_strategy_recommendation
primary.description: Selected deployment strategy with justification, comparison matrix, risk assessment, rollback approach

primary.name: implementation_plan
primary.description: Infrastructure requirements, traffic management configuration, health checks, automation scripts

primary.name: deployment_workflow_documentation
primary.description: Step-by-step procedures, checklists, validation steps, rollback triggers and procedures

primary.name: risk_mitigation_plan
primary.description: Identified risks, mitigation strategies, monitoring mechanisms, incident response procedures

primary.name: configuration_specifications
primary.description: Load balancer config, service mesh config, feature flag config, traffic routing rules

supporting.name: deployment_architecture_diagrams
supporting.description: Current state, target state, traffic flow, rollback flow, multi-region topology

supporting.name: monitoring_metrics_plan
supporting.description: Key metrics, alert definitions, dashboard specs, success criteria, baselines

supporting.name: testing_strategy
supporting.description: Pre-deployment testing, canary validation, smoke tests, performance tests, rollback testing

supporting.name: runbooks_and_procedures
supporting.description: Deployment runbook, rollback runbook, troubleshooting guide, escalation procedures

supporting.name: training_materials
supporting.description: Strategy overview, operator training, developer guidelines, FAQ, lessons learned

workflow.name: Strategy Evaluation
workflow.description: Evaluate deployment strategy options against requirements

workflow.name: Infrastructure Design
workflow.description: Design infrastructure to support chosen strategy

workflow.name: Traffic Management Configuration
workflow.description: Configure traffic routing for deployment strategy

workflow.name: Testing and Validation
workflow.description: Validate deployment strategy works as designed

workflow.name: Documentation and Training
workflow.description: Enable teams to execute deployment strategy

choose_when: Want to validate entire deployment before cutover
Want to test with real production traffic
Can route traffic based on criteria
Want to detect issues before full rollout
Have multiple instances to update incrementally
avoid_when: Database changes require all instances on same version

choose_when: Have database schema changes requiring downtime
Want to decouple deployment from release
Need to enable features for specific users
Want to gradually roll out features
avoid_when: Code complexity from flags is too high
Team lacks feature flag management discipline

strategy_selection: Strategy is compatible with application architecture
Strategy is appropriate for team maturity
infrastructure: Load balancer supports required traffic routing
Health checks accurately detect application health
Readiness probes prevent premature traffic routing

common_mistakes.impact: Strategy doesn't match requirements, causes deployment issues
common_mistakes.solution: Evaluate strategies objectively against specific requirements

common_mistakes.impact: Cannot implement chosen strategy, delays and rework
common_mistakes.solution: Assess infrastructure capabilities before strategy selection

common_mistakes.impact: Traffic routed to unhealthy instances, user-facing errors
common_mistakes.solution: Implement comprehensive health and readiness checks
Define clear rollback triggers and thresholds

examples.context: High-traffic e-commerce platform with microservices on Kubernetes
examples.strategy: Canary Deployment with Istio + Feature Flags

examples.context: Core banking application with strict regulatory compliance
key_results: Deployment downtime reduced from 4 hours to 30 seconds

examples.context: Mobile backend API with budget constraints
examples.strategy: Rolling Deployment with Sophisticated Health Checks + PodDisruptionBudget
key_results: Daily deployments with zero user-facing errors

examples.context: B2B SaaS with diverse customer requirements
